pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into active pullbacks or falling knives; additional tranches are strictly prohibited until the primary position achieves a +$10.00 floating cushion.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: No order execution within 5 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic data releases and without confirmed order-book imbalance confirmation via volume profile delta.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation or scale-out execution as soon as floating profit hits +$15.00, targeting a final exit ceiling of +$30.00.
